question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"started"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number **3** is **'started.'**
 
• **Started:** to begin doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** *I had just **started** to write a letter when the phone rang.*
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that Charles I began creating the title of Baronet and sold it to raise money.
